entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.1458/2023 which is fifth application under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant no.2-Surendra.
His last application for suspension has been dismissed as withdrawn on 26.04.2022.

Thereafter, appellant no.1-Gaurav has filed an application for suspension of sentence that too was dismissed by this Court against which he approached the Hon'ble Apex Court by way of SLP (Crl.)
11509/2022 and vide order 20.01.2023 the Apex Court has granted suspension to Gaurav only on the ground of 10 years 6 months 25 days of jail incarceration as on 23.08.2020 and appeal is not likely to be heard finally.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the allegation against this appellant is that Gourav caught hold the deceased and the present appellant ablaze him by pouring kerosene oil.
He is aged more than 60 years.
In the dying declaration the allegation is common against both of them.
He has also completed more than 11 years now hence having parity with co-accused Gourav.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.

The Hon'ble Apex Court while granting suspension to appellant no.1- Gourav has passed the following order:-
"Application seeking exemption from filing certified copy of the impugned Order is allowed.
The prayer in this Special Leave Petition is for suspension of sentence during pendency of the Criminal Appeal before the High Court of Madhya Pradesh at Indore.

sentences.text: The petitioner is a convict under Sections 302, 498A, 449, 342 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code: and has been sentenced to undergo life imprisonment.
4. The petitioner has already undergone sentence of more than 10 years, 6 months and 25 days as on 23-08-2022.
The Criminal Appeal filed by the petitioner is of the year 2016.
Though the appeal has been listed for hearing but it might take some time in final adjudication thereof.

5. Taking into consideration all the attending circumstances, but without expressing any views on the merits of the case, the sentence awarded to the petitioner is suspended and he is ordered to be released on bail, subject to his furnishing bail bonds to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
6. The petitioner, however, shall not delay the adjudication of the Criminal Appeal and shall fully cooperate in this regard.
7. In the event of any non-cooperation by the petitioner, the State of Madhya Pradesh shall be at liberty to seek cancellation of this Order.
8. The Special Leave Petition is disposed of in the above- terms."
Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case for suspension of the sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Hence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the matter I.A. No.1458/2023 is allowed and jail sentence of the appellant no.2- Surendra shall remain suspended.

I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, they shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 15.06.2023, and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) 
 JUDGE   RJ Gourav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36809250/
